g.text: f Single-head effects correlate across 4B and exploratory 8B scans

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Each point averages 4 dev seeds × 2 directions × 64 items. Red marks the six shared top-8 indices.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: 8B discovery used dev seeds only. Shared training or distillation is a possible explanation, not an established cause.
